scope: Frozen constructed probes only; no native or independent real-motion conclusion

metric_protocol.raw_input: stored noisy RAW before black-level clipping
metric_protocol.model_input: the same input after channel-wise black subtraction, [0,1] clipping and DN reconstruction
metric_protocol.storage_code_endpoints: exact storage codes 0 and 4095; distinct from black-level normalization endpoints
metric_protocol.normalized_domain_limits: channel-wise (DN-black)/(4095-black); endpoint tolerance 1e-7; raw below-black samples are not claimed to be hardware clipping
metric_protocol.acceptance: report separate reconstruction, structural and temporal target-relative errors; no single-metric pass claim

limitations: One seed and two sampling cycles; no significance or multi-seed replication claim.
Constructed probes derive from the A3 training reference, not independent real motion or cross-sensor data.
Refreshing was compared under a frozen source/gain schedule; three audited empty refresh samples were replaced offline and this protocol detail must be disclosed.
Shared first-cycle training already degraded moving-patch probes before the fixed/refresh fork.
EMA is the primary comparison; raw model states are diagnostics.
Native evaluations are excluded from this intermediate analysis.
